title: briza multiflora
intro: Briza multiflora, commonly known as Quaking Grass or Star of Persia, is a flowering plant belonging to the Poaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Briza multiflora include its use in traditional medicine to treat conditions such as bronchitis, coughs, and digestive issues, as well as its application in the treatment of wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
